maddeler.e:
اعتقدوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدُوا (iʕtaqadū) /iʕ.ta.qa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدُوا (uʕtuqidū) /uʕ.tu.qi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اِعْتَقِدُوا (iʕtaqidū) /iʕ.ta.qi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
